title: BEANS n' stuff
description: I let my brother use MCreator, this is the result
body:
I let my brother and I go crazy on MCreator and it ended up a crazy, yet fun mess

This mod adds a bunch of stuff to go explore that is random and of course, fun!
It is meant to add content that people want like biomes, blocks, new tiers of gear, and dimensions, in a silly way.

Mobs
Bob-is immune to normal attacks, can only be killed with potions
Df Tvefgsbje-can either drop beans bucket or new music disc

Fluids
Beans-Beans

Blocks-Chez Ore, Chez Block

Gear
Chez-can be mined with a wooden pickaxe, is as common as coal, is better than netherite

Biomes
Carl-can spawn in the overworld
Paul-can spawn in overworld caves

Dimensions
Chez-Spawns everything previously mentioned and more

PLEASE CHECK THE GALLERY FOR SOME MORE INFORMATION

This mod is currently only for forge 1.19.4

If you want to include this in a modpack (but why?) you don't need my permission

Have fun!
